sloka: को भवान् रूपसम्पन्नो दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः ।वसानो विरजे वस्त्रे दिव्याभरणभूषितः ।। ६.५०.४४ ।।।।
transliteration: ko bhavān rūpasampanno divyasraganulepanaḥ ।vasāno viraje vastre divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 6.50.44 ।।।।

translations.english: "Who are you, richly endowed with charming appearance, smeared with unguents adored in dust free garments, wearing beautiful ornaments?"
